entries.summary: Released 2026-08-25 — five days before this entry was written. Every score here is IBM's own; no independent leaderboard lists it, and the BFCL v3 figure in particular is a vendor number for a benchmark that has a public leaderboard it has not yet appeared on.

mitigations.note: Not a defect — a caveat. Scores will be revisited when independent measurements land.

citations.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built (IBM's own benchmark reporting)

entries.summary: The Granite 4 line has an open llama.cpp report of Q6/Q8 builds failing outright at very large contexts (100K–200K) — which is most of the advertised 131K window. Separately, Granite 4 chat-template auto-detection has failed in llama.cpp, producing subtly wrong prompting rather than an error.

mitigations.note: Track current llama.cpp and pass the chat template explicitly rather than relying on auto-detection. Both reports are runtime-side, not weights-side.
Retrieve rather than filling 100K+ of context — this sidesteps the failure entirely.
